name: github-automation-tests
description: Testes automatizados E2E e de performance para GitHub usando Cypress e K6

scripts.cypress:merge:reports: mochawesome-merge cypress/results/*.json -o cypress/results/merged-report.json && marge cypress/results/merged-report.json -f test-report -o cypress/results
scripts.k6:all: k6 run k6-tests/login-performance.test.js && k6 run k6-tests/repositories-performance.test.js && k6 run k6-tests/logout-performance.test.js

author: QA Analyst
